mapper.sql: id, student_number, name, gender, class_id, phone, email, address, birth_date, enrollment_date
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.student_number, s.name, s.gender, s.class_id, s.phone, s.email, s.address, s.birth_date, s.enrollment_date FROM student s ORDER BY s.id DESC
SELECT s.id, s.student_number, s.name, s.gender, s.class_id, s.phone, s.email, s.address, s.birth_date, s.enrollment_date FROM student s WHERE s.id = #{id}
SELECT s.id, s.student_number, s.name, s.gender, s.class_id, s.phone, s.email, s.address, s.birth_date, s.enrollment_date FROM student s WHERE s.student_number = #{studentNumber}
SELECT s.id, s.student_number, s.name, s.gender, s.class_id, s.phone, s.email, s.address, s.birth_date, s.enrollment_date FROM student s WHERE s.class_id = #{classId} ORDER BY s.student_number

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.student_number, s.gender, s.birth_date, s.phone, s.email, s.address, s.class_id, sc.class_name, s.enrollment_date, s.status FROM student s LEFT JOIN student_class sc ON s.class_id = sc.id WHERE s.status = #{status} ORDER BY s.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE student SET student_number = #{studentNumber}, name = #{name}, gender = #{gender}, class_id = #{classId}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, address = #{address}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, enrollment_date = #{enrollmentDate} WHERE id = #{id}

mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.name, s.student_number, s.gender, s.birth_date, s.phone, s.email, s.address, s.class_id, sc.class_name, s.enrollment_date, s.status FROM student s LEFT JOIN student_class sc ON s.class_id = sc.id WHERE s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.student_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY s.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student WHERE gender = #{gender}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student WHERE status = #{status}

SELECT sc.id as classId, sc.class_name as className, COUNT(s.id) as studentCount FROM student_class sc LEFT JOIN student s ON sc.id = s.class_id GROUP BY sc.id, sc.class_name ORDER BY studentCount DESC
SELECT sc.grade, COUNT(s.id) as studentCount FROM student_class sc LEFT JOIN student s ON sc.id = s.class_id GROUP BY sc.grade ORDER BY sc.grade DESC
SELECT YEAR(enrollment_date) as enrollmentYear, COUNT(*) as studentCount FROM student GROUP BY YEAR(enrollment_date) ORDER BY enrollmentYear DESC
